summary: #128797 remains the canonical bug. Current main appends the admitted direct-cron mirror and updates only updatedAt; idle reset instead reads lastInteractionAt. A narrow owner-boundary fix is appropriate, but this runner is read-only, has no ../codex checkout required by AGENTS.md, and cannot run pnpm because Corepack cannot create its cache.
